entries.value: measured EIA Henry Hub daily spot (data/raw/gas-prices/henry_hub_daily.csv), resampled onto calendar days and renormalized to mean exactly 1.0 per month (G-A1 fix 9037c89) so the monthly delivered level is byte-kept and only the intra-month swing rides on top; the same mean-preserving factors are re-carried onto every F923-overwritten gas plant-month. Bound: HH-ONLY — the eastern-hub daily-basis blowout beyond the HH move is not carried (chartered follow-on intake).

ZERO tunable values: the 0.55 guard, the coal-only detector, the 1-5-day cap and the in-merit filter are all UNCHANGED; the only deriver change is the guard's identification BASIS (raw-annual -> when-operable), cited to the measurement in docs/DIAGNOSIS-pjm-c3c-summer-tail-2026-07.md §7 (event-unit when-operable CF 0.58-0.72 vs raw-annual 0.09-0.36), NOT to any price residual.
entries.note: Physical availability event (rule 13); forecast-native analogue is the statistical WEFOR/POF draw; backcast-mode calibration input only. Re-derives ONLY on a CAMPD vintage change (rule 23), never on a residual. New-ISO intake of an existing datatype.

entries.name: campd-partial-outages-PJM.csv (unit_partial_outage_windows)
entries.source: unit-grain partial-derate plateaus (a unit running at a depressed CF ceiling, never zero) detected on each unit's own CAMPD gross with the plant-level partial detector's constants VERBATIM (_MIN_DAYS=5, _SMOOTH_DAYS=7, _CEILING_FRAC=0.65, _RUN_FLOOR_CF=0.06; scripts/derive_partial_outages._detect) + the same WHEN-OPERABLE baseload guard (0.55) + the same in-merit filter; unit derates aggregated to the plant exactly like the >= 5-day unit-outage overlay (unit-capacity share, concurrent units summed, clipped at full). ZERO tunable values (every constant inherited frozen). The plant-grain partial detector is measured to over-fire ~43 TWh/yr on PJM's cycling fleet and stays ERCOT-scoped; this is the unit-grain replacement.
entries.note: Physical availability event (rule 13); forecast-native analogue is the statistical WEFOR/derate-rate draw; backcast-mode calibration input only. Re-derives ONLY on a CAMPD vintage change (rule 23), never on a residual. New unit-grain datatype (per-ISO).
